18:15 Local Time, 16:15 GMT, 21:45 IST: It was a thoroughly dominant day for South Africa. Rain and a wet outfield washed out the opening session, but once play got underway, the Proteas took complete control, putting Bangladesh firmly on the back foot. Jansen provided South Africa with the first breakthrough, dismissing Tanzid early. After a useful partnership between Mahfijul Islam and Mominul Haque, Bangladesh's innings quickly unravelled as the Proteas bowlers ran through the batting line-up. Nortje brought an end to the partnership by dismissing Mahfijul Islam, and from there, the wickets continued to tumble as Bangladesh's innings fell apart.

Nortje, Jansen and Rabada ran through the Bangladesh batting line-up, making life extremely difficult for the visitors and bowling them out for a meagre 91. In response, the Proteas openers came out with positive intent, putting on 49 runs for the first wicket. Ebadot broke the stand by dismissing Markram, but that proved to be Bangladesh's only breakthrough as they failed to make further inroads. Marques Ackerman was given a chance thanks to a review not taken and Zubayr Hamza was dropped at first slip. With plenty of time left in the Test, South Africa are firmly in the driver's seat. The Proteas will look to pile on the runs tomorrow, build a commanding lead and bat Bangladesh out of the contest. We'll be back tomorrow for the coverage of Day 2. See you!
